# thinkpad

ThinkPad T14 hardware: microcode, audio DSP firmware, Intel video drivers, fingerprint reader, firmware updates and TLP power management.

TLP alone manages power (`root/etc/tlp.d/10-thinkpad.conf`). Deliberately not installed: power-profiles-daemon (conflicts with TLP) and thermald (exits on this T14; the firmware handles thermals).

powertop is installed as a diagnostic only (per-process CPU use and wakeups); its `--auto-tune` and `powertop.service` are never used, because TLP alone manages power.

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`thinkpad/packages`): `intel-ucode`, `sof-firmware`, `intel-media-driver`, `vulkan-intel`, `fprintd`, `fwupd`, `tlp`, `powertop` (diagnostic only; never --auto-tune: TLP owns the tunables)

**System files** (`thinkpad/root/`, copied by `install.sh --system`):

- `/etc/tlp.d/10-thinkpad.conf`

**`setup.sh`** (run by `install.sh --setup`): TLP manages power (its config comes from thinkpad/root/ via install.sh --system). Not installed on purpose: power-profiles-daemon (conflicts with TLP) and thermald (exits on this T14: "can't run on this platform"; the firmware, thinkpad_acpi DYTC, handles thermals).
